resources.string: ScrollSnooze can track app minutes in Instagram, YouTube, Facebook, Snapchat, Moj and ShareChat. Video-feed detection rules are candidates for Instagram and YouTube only and are not accuracy-validated; video counts are not available for Facebook, Snapchat, Moj or ShareChat yet. When an available video rule is active, ScrollSnooze reads limited player layout labels to distinguish items, converts labels to one-way codes and keeps counts on this phone. It never reads messages, takes screenshots, taps or types for you. Optional sync shares daily totals only.
Today’s confirmed short-video count on your home screen.
